newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2.165 bln for Oct 22.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2.165 bln for Oct 22.

text.p: Scheduled municipal bond sales total $2.165 billion in 50 offerings for Tuesday, October 22, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $1.095 billion in 25 offerings. The largest issue is a $500 million California general obligation bond issue at 1200 EDT.

Negotiated sales total $1.070 billion in 25 offerings. The largest issue is a $459 million New York City Transit Authority issue through Dillon Read. Possible negotiated sales for Tuesday total $88 million in four offerings. -----------------------------------------------------------
